expectations.text: The agent tags both comments as nits in the plan
expectations.evidence: The baseline has no nit concept; it presented the two comments as ordinary fixes with no nit tag/indicator in any plan output.

expectations.text: The agent recognizes that every actionable comment is a nit and triggers the nits-only gate instead of proceeding
expectations.evidence: No nits-only gate exists in the baseline; the agent proceeded directly to applying both edits.

expectations.text: The agent halts and does not auto-apply or commit the nit fixes before the user makes a choice
expectations.evidence: The baseline applied both edits (rename and typo fix) and committed them without halting for a user decision.

expectations.text: The agent presents a per-nit decision table and a prompt offering fix-all / skip-all / issue-all / select
expectations.evidence: No decision table or fix-all/skip-all/issue-all/select prompt appeared; the baseline has no such workflow.
